findings.summary: V217 public-search URL repair can misread comment-only guard markers as a healthy bounded request path
findings.note: Pinned protected-main module _has_all checks literal substrings and detect() treats the presence of three marker strings as proof of a bounded public-search URL guard. A synthetic unsafe function with the identical guard markers solely in comments yields detect()=None and transform() returns the unchanged unsafe text for all three V217 allowlisted paths (Bing multi-route, Google News, V144 social). Read-only characterization tests reproduce this blind spot without external calls. This demonstrates a rule-integrity false negative if source is altered; it does not show that current active collectors have unsafe URLs or that an external SSRF boundary is bypassed. Fix requires syntax-aware or control-flow-aware rule verification and a separately reviewed successor if watched source is modified. No release or device approval.
